name: footer-bar
notes: The footer is the only place the token / cost / turn counters live, and it is rendered from chunk[5] — a fixed 2-row budget that a regression in any of the five sibling chunks can steal. usage.json is what makes the token glyphs non-zero, so this also pins the up/down arrows and their column alignment. ENV: the left third shows model · provider, which come from operant.toml.
